home.title: Documents
home.lead: Letters, notices and certificates issued by the system, with their delivery status and proof. Filter the library, or open a document from the lookup below the table.
home.typeHelp: As in the object reference, for example Policy or Claim.
home.typeInvalid: Enter the object type (letters and digits).
home.subjectIdHelp: The id of the policy, claim or other object.

subject.invalidTitle: This object reference is not valid
subject.invalidBody: Use a module code ({modules}), an object type and an id, for example POL/Policy/1234. Go back and look the object up again.
subject.title: Documents of the object
subject.notFound: The object was not found in your legal entity.
subject.emptyBody: No document has been issued for this object yet.

detail.title: {type}
detail.notFound: The document was not found in your legal entity.
detail.subject: About

deliveries.title: Deliveries
deliveries.emptyBody: The document has not been sent yet.

evidence.title: Provider evidence
evidence.emptyBody: Proof of delivery arrives from the postal or email provider.

reprint.title: Reprint
reprint.lead: Issues a marked reprint copy of this document. The reason is kept in the audit trail.
reprint.doneBody: The copy appears among the deliveries as a reprint.

library.title: Document library
library.emptyBody: Change the filters, or show hidden documents.
library.loadFailed: The next page could not be loaded

lookup.title: Open a specific document
lookup.lead: Look documents up by the object they are about, or open one by its id.

archive.title: Stored letter
archive.verifyOkBody: The stored letter matches its recorded hash.
archive.verifyTamperedBody: The stored bytes do not match the recorded hash. Computed hash:
archive.downloadFailedBody: The stored letter could not be fetched. Try again; if it persists, report it with the time.
archive.exportedBody: A sealed pack with {count} document(s) was stored.

completeness.title: Archive completeness
completeness.lead: Checks that every issued letter has its archived copy and that the stored hash still matches. Read-only; capped at 2000 documents per run.
completeness.truncatedBody: Narrow the date range to cover every document.
completeness.emptyBody: No document was issued in this range.

kinds.HASH_MISMATCH: Archive hash differs from the stored bytes
kinds.DOCUMENT_HASH_DIFFERS: Document hash differs from the archive

lifecycle.channelHelp: A statutory notice is always sent by registered post.
lifecycle.replacementHelp: An issued document about the same subject.

resend.title: Resend {number}
resend.lead: Sends the archived letter again as a new delivery. The reason is kept in the audit trail.

hide.title: Hide {number}
hide.lead: Removes the document from the default lists. The letter, archive and deliveries are kept.

unhide.title: Unhide {number}
unhide.lead: Returns the document to the default lists.

supersede.title: Supersede {number}
supersede.lead: Links this document to the one that replaces it. Nothing is edited or deleted. A statutory notice needs the administrator role.

withdraw.title: Withdraw {number}
withdraw.lead: Marks the document as withdrawn with no replacement. The archive and delivery evidence are kept. A statutory notice needs the administrator role.
